problem: Companion interruptibility already rechecks latest state at delivery, but product acceptance should preserve N.E.K.O's distinct policies for focused-work break reminders, focus-to-leisure anti-slack reminders, game invitations and ordinary proactive activity instead of treating every proactive event as one generic message class.

native_policy_classes.work_break: focused_work accumulator arms a bounded pending reminder; reminder ownership/consumption is explicit
native_policy_classes.anti_slack: recent sufficiently-long focused_work to leisure transition queues a distinct reminder with cooldown and invalidation
native_policy_classes.game_invite: mini-game delivery is leisure-only and separate from ordinary proactive
native_policy_classes.ordinary_proactive: ActivitySnapshot propensity/tone plus latest-state admission handles ordinary proactive delivery
native_policy_classes.focused_video: sustained video immersion has its own propensity/tone and dwell reset behavior

selected.mechanism: repeat existing native policy-class and ownership tests inside the existing Companion Runtime soak
cases: work break pending arms at threshold and persists until consumed
break accumulator extends through short transitioning but resets outside focus
long suspend/gap cannot synthesize fake focus minutes
anti-slack fires only after sufficient focus-to-leisure transition, not idle/too-short focus, and honors cooldown
anti-slack pending clears on return to focused work
focused-video dwell/propensity is distinct from generic entertainment
repeat-suppressed break reminders consume pending source
all break reminder branches consume repeat suppression
break reminder respects round ownership and stops if round retires during generation
work-break theater prompt only invites from a frozen public opening

acceptance: policy-class tests run inside each SOAK_ROUNDS iteration
latest upstream policy/test blobs are unchanged from the current product pin
work reminder, anti-slack, game invite and ordinary proactive remain distinct native semantics
no second activity daemon, proactive scheduler, notification policy engine or reminder database is added
retirement_condition: Retire the private repeated selection when N.E.K.O ships an integrated multi-round proactive policy-class soak or materially replaces the native ActivitySnapshot/tracker policy seams.
